commission.otherworldinn.description.adv: The Adventurers Guild has issued a patrol commission: please clear out roaming Endermen and carefully recover their samples.
The Adventurers Guild has issued a Nether subjugation commission: slay the Blazes and eliminate the Wither Skeleton threat.
The Adventurers Guild has issued a defense commission: eliminate the Raiders and Evokers to secure the village from their looming threat.
The Adventurers Guild has issued a high-risk commission: venture into the Deep Dark and slay a Warden.
commission.otherworldinn.description.api: The gardener is putting together an ecological record of bees. Head to the Overworld, capture at least one bee in action on film, and bring it to her.
commission.otherworldinn.description.bui: The builder plans to add copper accents to the shopfronts. Please provide several copper casings.
The builder recently took on a fine interior project and needs to procure bricks and glass.
The builder requires sand and gravel to mix construction mortar.
The builder is about to lay a new foundation and requires a massive supply of stone.
The builder is currently short on timber. Please deliver a batch of logs and planks.
commission.otherworldinn.description.but: The butcher is offering a high price for rare materials. Help him gather some rabbit's feet and ink sacs.
The butcher took on a leather order but lacks raw materials. Help gather enough leather and bone meal to complete production.
The butcher needs to restock on raw meat. Please provide some pork and beef.
The butcher is buying up poultry in bulk. Prepare a batch of fresh chicken and eggs for him.
The butcher plans to open a ready-to-eat seafood section. Provide some canned herring and tuna sandwiches for a trial run.
The butcher plans to expand into the aquatic market. Provide some fish products for a market assessment.
The butcher's seafood counter is adding shellfish to the menu. Help provide a batch of live clams and cooked clam meat for the shelves.
commission.otherworldinn.description.dee: The Vigil Feast will last until the dawn of the new year, and catering supplies are urgently needed. Prepare plenty of hot food and warm sweet berry drinks for the guests.
The Ice Sculpture Carnival has officially begun, and building materials are urgently needed. Gather ice, snow blocks, and a small amount of packed ice for the grand finale sculpture.
The supply crew plans to scout the snowfield roads before the festival. Take a photo of the environment for reference, and gather some snowballs just in case.
The Deep Winter Festival is gathering winter supplies for lodging travelers. Help collect wool, leather, and coal to bring warmth to the guests.
commission.otherworldinn.description.eco: The fisherman reports a faint glow appearing frequently in the deep waters. Dive down, investigate, and take a clear photograph as an investigative record.
The ants are busy ferrying supplies between their hills. Help the farmer take a picture of their hard work in the ant garden.
A large number of crabs have appeared on the shore after low tide. Head there and take a clear photograph of a coastal crab for the butcher's research.
Flightless dodos inhabit the Dodo Island. Travel there, take a picture, and bring back an ecological photograph of a dodo.
Lava-formed guards roam the volcanic island. While ensuring your own safety, take a photograph of a firekeeper from a distance for the magician.
Hoarding hamsters dwell in the open grasslands. Help the farmer by taking a clear photograph of a hamster in action.
The herring in the sea have formed schools. Help the fisherman by taking an ecological photograph with at least three herring in the same frame.
The magician is quite interested in intelligent marine creatures that hide in shells. Track down an octopus and take a photograph of it.
Gentle sea cows typically inhabit the seagrass meadows. Head to the area and take a photograph of a sea cow in its natural habitat for the fisherman.
Colorful seahorses drift through the coral reefs. Dive into the area and bring back a photographic record of a seahorse for the fisherman.
Many snail shells are scattered around the vegetable garden. Help the farmer find a living snail and take a photograph for the records.
Spider crabs that spit frozen bubbles lurk in the frigid waters. Dive underwater and take a clear photograph of this creature for the butcher.
The magician has a keen interest in waxed constructs that actively attack monsters. Track down a Stranded and take a photograph for her.
Massive tuna swim in the vast ocean. Set sail to track them down and bring a photograph of a tuna to the butcher.
commission.otherworldinn.description.far: The farm needs to replenish its animal feed. Please help deliver some wheat and carrots.
The orchard has welcomed a bountiful apple harvest, and the farmer plans to make apple platters. Provide a few finished platters as a reference.
The farm plans to lay a shell-tile path and build a circular flower bed. Help gather materials like snail shell tiles and sunflowers.
The beekeeper's mead is nearly sold out, and demand is high. Provide a few bottles of high-quality mead to restock the inventory.
Thirst-quenching drinks are desperately needed for the hot summer fieldwork. Help prepare a batch of refreshing melon juice to meet the demand.
The farm needs to bolster its defenses. Please help clear out the hostile mobs in the surrounding area.
The farmhands are eager to learn the craft of making sticky rice cakes. Provide a batch of sticky rice cakes for them to observe and taste.
The farmer plans to introduce and trial a new batch of crops. Help gather sunflower seeds and dates to support the agricultural experiment.
The farm is about to start a new crop rotation cycle and urgently needs to restock various seeds. Please help collect and provide them.
The farmer plans to buy sun-shading straw hats for the hired hands. Prepare a batch of plain straw hats and one with floral decorations.
The farm's food reserves are currently running critically low. Please help deliver a batch of staple supplies.
The patrol squad needs to update its records of zombie activity. Head to the Overworld, capture footage of at least one roaming zombie, and submit it.
commission.otherworldinn.description.fis: The fisherman has posted a bounty for a specific fresh fish. Catch the target fish according to the request and bring it back to complete this angling commission.
commission.otherworldinn.description.for: The town guard requires a new issue of armor. Please provide the blacksmith with the necessary forging materials.
The blacksmith plans to upgrade the forge's firepower. Help acquire two blaze burners to complete the modification.
The blacksmith is preparing to cast a new batch of brass mechanisms. Collect and provide the required brass ingots and brass sheets.
The blacksmith wishes to study kinetic mechanisms. Help gather a batch of cogwheels and shafts for testing.
The blacksmith is dedicated to researching the core components of advanced machinery. Help gather a batch of electron tubes to advance this research.
The forge's fuel reserves are nearly depleted. Please deliver a batch of coal as soon as possible to ensure forging operations continue smoothly.
The forge urgently needs to restock its spare metal parts. Deliver a batch of basic materials in advance for processing.
The blacksmith is preparing to forge an unparalleled masterpiece, and the material requirements are extremely high. Help seek out and provide the finest forging materials.
The blacksmith wishes to dismantle precision mechanisms to study their internal structure. Please provide two components in exchange for brass.
Some facilities on the outskirts of town are in desperate need of maintenance. We are now recruiting hands and collecting various materials needed for repairs.
The blacksmith recently took on a batch of weapon orders and now needs to procure high-grade metal materials.
commission.otherworldinn.description.gro: The grocer received a bulk order for conveyor belts from a farm owner. Help the grocer prepare the stock to fulfill the order.
The grocer is stockpiling supplies for the upcoming festival. Help provide several bottles of champagne to expand the inventory.
The grocer's deli section plans to launch a new dish. Provide a few portions of Dongpo pork as samples for the trial run.
The grocer plans to introduce a batch of quick-cook dumplings. Provide a steamer of dumplings first as a sample for quality inspection.
The grocer plans to trial some exotic ingredients. Bring some qingtuan and fried spring rolls for the owner to evaluate.
The grocer's hardware shelf urgently needs a restock of funnels. Prepare a batch of andesite funnels and brass funnels.
The grocer is currently buying up high-quality stone in bulk. Help collect and deliver them to the shop.
The grocer plans to add copper plumbing to their sales catalog. Provide a batch of fluid pipes to stock the shelves.
The grocer's timber stock is critically low. Deliver a batch of common planks as soon as possible to restock.
A construction crew ordered a set of mixed stone samples from the grocer. Help gather tuff, deepslate, and other stones for delivery.
The grocer is preparing to stock a batch of specialty liquors. Provide several bottles of plum wine and ice wine to test the market response.
commission.otherworldinn.description.har: To brew the winter sweet wine, this year's bountiful harvest must be properly cellared. Help prepare brewing supplies like wooden barrels, apples, and honey.
The Harvest Parade urgently needs beautifully decorated floats. Gather wheat, pumpkins, and apples to add a festive harvest atmosphere to the floats.
The head chef of the Harvest Feast urgently needs prep assistants. Prepare pumpkin pies, golden carrots, and a large quantity of cooked meat for the grand banquet.
commission.otherworldinn.description.mag: The magician has recently developed a keen interest in exotic teas. Help gather some flower tea and barley tea for her to taste.
The magician plans to study ghostly mucus infused with phantom membranes. Help craft two pieces of the required material and deliver them to her.
The magician heard of a luminous floral brew that exists in this world. Seek it out and bring back a bottle to satisfy her curiosity.
The magician's private library is in desperate need of organization. While helping to tidy up, keep an eye out for and collect any valuable ancient texts.
The magician plans to serve two special beverages at the banquet. Prepare two bottles each of Luminous Bride and Mother Snow for the guests.
The magician's potion experiments urgently require snail mucus as a core ingredient. Help collect some mucus to advance the experiment.
The magician's potion inventory is running low and needs a restock of basic alchemical ingredients.
The magician intends to taste and compare the qualities of premium teas. Gather top-grade Tieguanyin and Biluochun for her evaluation.
The magician is about to conduct an important ritual and urgently needs to acquire extremely rare materials.
The magician's latest research is facing a shortage of materials. Help gather a series of rare magical research components.
commission.otherworldinn.description.mid: The bonfire party is planned to be relocated to the seaside. Take a photograph of an ocean biome as a venue reference, and prepare some melons for the party.
The Midsummer Night Festival has attracted a large influx of travelers. Help prepare plenty of beds and rations to properly accommodate the arriving guests.
The garden party's lantern and firework displays are still missing key materials. Help gather glowstone, amethyst, and gunpowder to ensure the celebration goes smoothly.
To ensure the safety and peace of the Midsummer Night Festival, help clear out the skeletons and spiders that roam at night and maintain order in the area.
commission.otherworldinn.description.net: The Adventurers Guild urgently needs sighting footage of Ghasts to update the Nether navigation archives. Head to the Nether and take a clear photograph of at least one Ghast.
commission.otherworldinn.description.pas: The ranch currently needs to update its livestock records. Take a photograph containing at least one cow; there is no need to clear the background.
commission.otherworldinn.description.pla: The farm recorder needs photographs of the plains environment to assist in compiling this season's cultivation notes. Head to a plains biome, take a landscape photo, and submit it.
commission.otherworldinn.description.roa: The town patrol has issued a request for support. Help clear out skeleton threats along the way and provide the patrol members with food and tool supplies.
commission.otherworldinn.description.sno: The supply caravan plans to assess the passage conditions of the snowfield in advance. Head to the snowy plains biome and take a landscape photograph as a road condition reference.
commission.otherworldinn.description.spr: The beekeeper plans to use the Spring Festival to take a census of the hives. Help by taking a photograph of a bee, and bring back a few bottles of honey for inspection.
The streets are in desperate need of floral decorations for the Spring Festival. Help prepare and deliver a batch of spring flowers, pink petals, and flower pots.
The town plans to renovate the courtyards during the Spring Festival. Help gather gardening materials like bone meal, moss, and azalea bushes.
The children are hoping to make kites for the Spring Festival. Drive away the bothersome Phantoms to collect their membranes, and prepare enough paper for the crafting.
commission.otherworldinn.description.tow: Traces of spider activity have appeared inside the warehouse. Head there to clear them out as soon as possible to ensure the safety of the stored goods.
The town is currently building a strategic reserve of emergency supplies. Help gather ample food and various emergency items.
The Harvest Festival banquet is still short on desserts. Prepare and deliver cakes, cookies, and pumpkin pies to enrich the feast.
The night security on the outskirts of town has been concerning lately. Help patrol and clear out the wandering zombies to ensure the town's safety.
Some of the town's roads are in desperate need of maintenance and repair. Help gather and provide the stone and wood needed for the repairs.
dialogue.otherworldinn.blacksmith.greeti: What are you buying? The goods are on the rack, just don't touch the armor I just forged.
You again. Are you here to fix your pickaxe this time, or looking for some sturdy metal materials?
Don't stand in the doorway blocking the light. Speak up if you need something, I've got a few more commissions to finish.
Back again? Looks like the tools I forge suit your hands well enough.
dialogue.otherworldinn.blacksmith.node.a: Ores, ingots, tools, materials — have a look, take what suits you.
dialogue.otherworldinn.blacksmith.node.r: The forge fire is roaring. If you want something forged, speak up now.
dialogue.otherworldinn.blacksmith.node.t: You actually fixed it? Beautiful work! Now our machines can get spinning again.
No one has repaired the boiler room downstairs for a long time. I don't even know if it still works.
Turn right ahead, pass through the market, then take the small alley on the right.
Thanks to that mine, the good materials are flowing in endlessly now. You really did me a huge favor.
The mine over there broke down a while back. If it were fixed, getting ores would be a lot easier.

dialogue.otherworldinn.blacksmith_spring: Ores, ingots, tools, and materials are all right here. Pick whatever catches your eye.

That old boiler room underground has been sitting idle for ages. I don't even know if it can still spark a fire.
Go straight, turn right, pass through the market, and take a right again. It's at the very end of that small alleyway.
That abandoned mineshaft over there collapsed a while ago. If someone could go fix it, I wouldn't have to worry about ores for my forging.
The inn's structure looks solid enough. Do you need an expansion or a renovation?
A large house is definitely comfortable to live in, but the foundation needs to be dug deep enough.
Want to take a look at these blueprints? As long as you have the materials ready, leave the rest to me.
I've been a part of many massive projects back in the day, you can definitely count on me for a small job like this.
dialogue.otherworldinn.builder.node.ask_: Timber, stone, bricks — all here. What were you after?
dialogue.otherworldinn.builder.node.root: Looking to build a house? You've found the right person!
dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_deep_wint: Timber, stone, bricks — all here. What were you after?
I just inspected everyone's roofs before winter set in, so no amount of snow will crush them now. Do you need to stock up on some timber for the winter?
dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_harvest_f: Timber, stone, bricks — all here. What were you after?
If the parade floats fall apart, don't come crying to me... Haha, just kidding, come find me anytime if you need repairs!
dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_midsummer: Timber, stone, bricks — all here. What were you after?
I built the festival stage myself. Solid as a rock — dance all you like.
dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_spring_fe: Timber, stone, bricks — all here. What were you after?
Repairs on the town start after the festival — resting while I can. Need building supplies?
Now that's a fat pig... Oh, not you of course. What do you need?
Mind the floor, all wet. Knocked the bucket over just now.
Buy it or don't. Stop poking at it.
dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.node.ask_: Raw meat, leather, bones — come by when you run short.
dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.node.root: Fresh meat, just butchered! What do you need?
dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.node.smal: Beef and pork sell best, though it depends on the season.
dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_deep_wint: Raw meat, leather, bones — come by when you run short.

Leave the roast to me. Look at that marbling — harvest-year hogs are something else.

dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.greeting.0: Oh good, give me a hand with this.
dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.greeting.2: Tried these? Sweet-sour. ...Fine, they're a bit sour.
dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.greeting.3: Reckon it's going to rain again?
dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.node.ask_g: Seeds, crops, tools — take your time.
dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.node.root: Fresh harvest just came in. Need anything?
dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.node.topic: You actually got it repaired. Thank you for putting in the work.

dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_deep_winte: Seeds, crops, tools — take your time.

dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_spring_fes: Seeds, crops, tools — take your time.

dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.greetin: What I catch goes in that box over there.
I ought to sell you some bait and tackle.
dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.node.as: Fish, seafood, and all sorts of junk pulled out of the sea.
dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.node.ro: Today's catch is decent. Take a look?
dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.node.sm: Patience is enough. Rain helps, and so does the season and time of day.
dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_deep_wi: Fish, seafood, and all sorts of junk pulled out of the sea.

dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_harvest: Fish, seafood, and all sorts of junk pulled out of the sea.

dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_midsumm: Fish, seafood, and all sorts of junk pulled out of the sea.

dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.greeting.1: No haggling. Pick what you want.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.greeting.2: Can't go lower, friend. Any less and I'm losing money.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.greeting.3: That blacksmith can't tell good goods from junk! Last time he came in— forget it. What're you buying?
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.node.ask_g: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.node.root: What do you want to buy? I have everything.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_deep_winte: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
New Year goods and fireworks have arrived! A vigil should be loud and bright — come pick some out.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_harvest_fe: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
The shelves can barely hold the bounty! Pumpkin pies, cakes, festival fare — plenty for all.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_midsummer_: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
Records and treats for the night are all stocked. Guests are pouring in — first come, first served.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_spring_fes: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
Spring festival stock's out! Saplings, fertilizer — don't miss them if you're dressing the place up.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pack_: I leave before dawn tomorrow. Please prepare breakfast early.
Run around all day — first thing you want is something hot.
The wheel's loose. Is there a blacksmith nearby?
My shoulders are numb from carrying. Need a good night's rest.
I'll pass through on the return trip. Save me a room.
The road ahead is rough. Need to rest well before continuing.
Traveling with this much cargo, a safe stop is priceless.
Let me stash these crates here. Keep them out of the rain.
Sky looks bad. Good thing I found somewhere to stay.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_ba: After a long day's travel, a hot bath is exactly what I need.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_be: This bed looks comfortable. Hope the blankets are warm enough.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_ch: I leave at dawn tomorrow. Tonight, I just need good rest.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_fi: The fireplace is so warm. Would be nice to read a book here.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_fo: I heard the home-style cooking here is good. Should try it tonight.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_me: This place reminds me of an old inn from my childhood.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_mo: The morning air is refreshing. Good for a walk.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_ra: Staying at the inn during rain was a wise choice.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_re: A friend recommended this place. It hasn't disappointed.
I'll stay here again next time I pass through.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_we: The wind outside is harsh. Glad it's calm in the inn.
This place feels warmer than I expected. I might sleep well tonight.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_busine: The atmosphere here is suitable for business discussions.
The bedding has decent texture. Is it cotton?
I'm paying premium for peace and quiet. Don't disappoint.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_referr: I'll recommend this place to other discerning friends.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_room.n: The room is elegantly decorated, though it lacks a walk-in closet.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_servic: If the service stays this refined, I'll return often.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_standa: For this price range, the service standard is acceptable.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_tip.no: Good care deserves a tip when I check out.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_view.n: The view from the window is nice, though not oceanfront.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_wine.n: A fine wine with dinner would make this place perfect.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_app: Thank you for maintaining the authentic feel. It's rare.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_com: This place feels like home. The guests are all friendly.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_fut: Looking forward to the inn's future development. I'll keep watching.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_gro: It's heartwarming to see the inn improving.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_imp: What else needs improvement? I can offer suggestions.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_pho: The vibe here is great. I want to take a commemorative photo.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_rec: I'll recommend this place to more friends. Good places should be shared.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_ren: The renovations made this place so much nicer. Well done.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_sup: Keep it up. I'll keep supporting this inn.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_tra: The old inn charm is well preserved. It has character.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_rich_: My itinerary is confidential. Do not disclose it.
My standards are exceptionally high. I hope you can meet them.
My luggage is valuable. Security must not fail.
This inn has investment potential. I'll keep an eye on it.
An old inn is something else. Real depth to it, hey.
Details define quality. The pillow height must be perfect.
I dislike interruptions. Make sure your staff knows that.
Assign your most experienced staff. No trainees.
This suite is acceptable. I expect absolute quiet at night.
The decor shows some taste. Are these pieces authentic?
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_advance: I'll place an order later. Use your finest ingredients.
Get it done right, and your cut won't be forgotten.
My attendants arrive later. Get things ready first.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_feedbac: The service process is well-standardized. I'll report upward.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_ordinar: The service is excellent. I'll leave a positive review.
My schedule is tight. Wake me on time, please.
A pot of hot tea to the room would be lovely.
dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.greeting: Oh. You're here. Hang on a second—
I knew you'd come. Impressive, right?
There you are! How much money you got for me? ...No — what are you buying?
dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.node.ask: Materials and tomes are ready. Mind the explosive stuff.
dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.node.roo: The arcane stirs. What do you seek?
dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_deep_win: Materials and tomes are ready. Mind the explosive stuff.
Long nights are made for reading and experiments, and the winter stars are sharp... Just say what you need.
dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_harvest_: Materials and tomes are ready. Mind the explosive stuff.
Even the scent of harvest finds its way into medicine. A generous season. Have a look at my stock.
dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_midsumme: Materials and tomes are ready. Mind the explosive stuff.
The night's glow is captivating — I'm studying a luminous brew... Was there something you needed?
dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_spring_f: Materials and tomes are ready. Mind the explosive stuff.
The air of returning life does wonders for potion brewing... Oh, shopping? Browse freely.

Sorry, don't have those right now

Then take your time and see
Let me go look for them

Why don't you and the draught both stay

At least you've brewed a finished batch

Sorry, I may never run across such a place

Then research it through to the end
Then I'll gladly keep this brush
Let me read the next notes when ready
Let me see if I can find some
Take these tools and start digging
Sounds like you've dug deep enough

dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_cart: Sure. I'll keep an eye out for a seascape for you
I don't think I can help with that this time
Don't have any, figure it out
Save it for next time then
Thanks, I'll keep this gift safe
Seems like this place suits you

Looks like I didn't help you much this time
At least I brought back a clue

Sorry, I can't gather all that this time

Then keep the fire going for now

Save me the first bite when it's ready
Let me go prepare them for you
Alright, I'll put it together for you
Why not stay and fire up the kitchen
Maybe try a few more rounds
At least you've found the flavor
At least you've seen how many mouths this place can feed
dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_gem_: Sure, I'll take a look for you
Sorry, not visiting any caves this time
Sorry, I can't gather that much right now
Save it for next time then
May your next deal go smoothly
Then go ahead and open shop
You'd better guard the rest well
Sounds like you've got it figured out
Let me see when you put out the good stuff
Let me go look for them
Alright, let me help you pack those
I'd say this place is worth your goods
I don't think this place is quite there yet
I'd say don't stake all your capital yet
dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_mins: Sure, I'll keep an eye out next time
I may not have the time this round
Then save it for next time
Then I'll wait for your return
May the road still give you songs
Then I'll wait to hear the full song
May the next road still give you an audience
Save the next verse for me
Take these and make good use of them
Perhaps neither of us caught the right moment this time
Finish your song, then we'll talk about staying
At least you've found the inspiration
At least you've written down what you meant to sing
dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_nobl: Fine, I'll go look for you
Sorry, I can't spare that much right now
Sorry, I may never make it to such a place
Then stay and make peace with it
You can drop the tough act now
Let me go look for them
Here, take this to keep going
At least what you carry inside is still there
What you have now should last you a while
Why not just stay for now
dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_old_: Sorry, don't have those materials right now
Then get your kit settled first
Since you're weary, rest your feet here for a while.
Take my advice, don't wander so far afield anymore.
After half a lifetime on the road, it's time you enjoyed some peace.
Then settle down and retire here in peace.
You rest. I'll go see if I can find them for you.
Here, take these supplies for now.
Don't push yourself so hard. Why not just rest here?
They're your own two feet. If you want to leave, I won't stop you.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_alchemist_s: Excellent! The vessels, solvents, and materials are all finally here. Now I just need to master the proper heat.
Alas, I'll just have to make do with these leftover dregs. Whether the brew succeeds is entirely up to luck.

The samples I gathered on the road lost their potency before I even arrived! How infuriating. Could you find me two Nether Warts, one Blaze Powder, and a Glass Bottle? I need to brew this urgent potion right away.
A rough shot is fine, as long as I can recognize the terrain of a Nether Fortress.
Never mind then, I'll look for substitute materials. After all, the principles of alchemy are all interconnected.

I've been repeatedly testing the materials I have on hand, but I still lack a reliable reference for the heat. If you happen to pass by a Nether Fortress, please take a photo for me. I want to observe the temperature of the flames and the texture of the netherrack to see if they meet my experimental needs.
The data gathered this time is too sparse to draw any decent conclusions. But no matter, what is alchemy without a few failures? I'm going to travel elsewhere to gather the missing materials.
These past few days of experiments have left me covered in soot, but I've finally brewed a perfect batch! I've completely gotten my touch back. Now I must carefully consider where to use this potion.
Very well. I'll leave this highest-quality potion with you for protection.

Although I've managed to brew a drinkable potion, it's still far from the perfection I seek. Take this bottle as thanks for your help. I must continue my search for the next set of experimental materials.
I've been burying myself in researching new formulas lately. My past experiments never met expectations, so I started wondering: what if my foundational theories were wrong all along?
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_alchemist_v: Today I'm trying to brew a potion that works without Blaze Powder. I just hope it doesn't fail me at a critical moment.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_archaeologi: Thank you so much! You've saved me a great deal of trouble. For an archaeologist, being without proper tools is almost worse than being without a brain.
Then I'll just have to dig slowly by hand, the old-fashioned way. It's not impossible, just terribly inefficient.

I am ninety percent certain that a forgotten ancient civilization lies buried deep within the strata of this continent! But to bring it to light, I need to make preparations. Could you lend me an Iron Pickaxe and sixteen Torches? Next time, I will surely bring back decisive clues!
It doesn't need to be perfectly composed. As long as the architectural structure of the entrance is clearly recognizable, that's enough for me to write two whole papers!
Fair enough. The ruins aren't going to grow legs and run away; there will always be another chance. I'll just organize my current field notes for now.

I've thoroughly studied all the documents and fragments I have, and now all I lack is a convincing field photograph. If you pass by a Desert Pyramid or a Jungle Temple, be sure to take a picture for me! The entrance structure, the weathering of the stone bricks—these are incredibly precious data.
I'm still missing the final key sample, so I don't plan on leaving. I'll stay right here and dig until every last secret is unearthed.
Perfect! The puzzle is finally complete, and all the clues connect! Take this archaeological brush that has accompanied me for years; it's been an immense help in cleaning artifacts.

Even though you didn't find many clues for me this time, it only makes me more certain that there's something huge hidden here. After all, ruins that can be figured out at a glance are too boring; these tough mysteries are the real thrill!

The value of these two samples is simply immeasurable! Although the previous chain of evidence was a bit fragmented, with these, the research can fully advance. Take this brush—it handles excellently and is the sturdiest tool I've ever used.

After days and nights of intense study, the truth is on the verge of being revealed! With just one Echo Shard and one Ancient Debris as control samples, this research will be completely validated! Would you be willing to lend me a hand once more?
I've recently been doing a systematic reorganization of the nearby strata structures and weathering traces. The geographical environment here truly is a natural laboratory.
I've made quite a few new discoveries lately. There are far more treasures buried around here than I ever imagined!
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_cartographe: You're a lifesaver! Once I finish drawing up this nautical chart, I'll definitely come back and buy you a drink!
No worries, I'll figure out a way to make do. The key landmarks are still in my head anyway; as long as I don't get lost, I'll be fine.

Hey, just the person I wanted to see! I've been braving the sea breeze for two days; I'm almost out of paper, and I even snapped a quill. If you have three pieces of Paper and a Feather on hand, could you lend them to me? Next time we meet, I'll show you something truly rare!
Just snap anything, I'll take any view of the sea! Waves, morning fog, the horizon—anything you capture will help me calibrate these blasted map coordinates.
Alright then, I'll just fill in the other blank areas on the map first. I can slowly verify the coastal details the next time I get a chance.

The paper and pen you lent me last time were a huge help; the nautical chart is mostly filled in. Now I just need a photo of the ocean to cross-reference with my tide records. Next time you head out, could you snap a picture of the seascape for me?

I originally planned to give this compass only to someone who truly helped me. But now it seems a compass alone isn't enough to express my gratitude. Please take these gold coins as well, as a token of my appreciation.
There are always missed sights on a journey. No matter, I'll just keep these missing details in mind for now. Let's chat about happier things next time we meet.
Thank you for finding these items for me. I want you to have this old compass; it might just come in handy on your future travels.

I've braved the wind and rain across many lands lately, and my pack is overflowing with sketches. It's time to sit down and sort through them properly. Here, take a look and see if there are any drafts you can use.
I've finally found a flat table where I can peacefully spread out my sketches. When I was rushing along the road, I was always terrified my maps would blow away in the wind.
While the images are still fresh in my mind, I need to get them down on paper. When I come back next time, I promise to tell you an even more thrilling tale of adventure!
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage0: Yes, that's the exact flavor! You know, to cook well, you have to taste a hundred different home-cooked meals to find real inspiration.
Alright then, I'll just try to make do with some other ingredients for now.

I'm developing new dishes for next season, but I feel they're lacking a bit of local flavor. Could you help me put together an authentic home-style meal? Bread, Steak, Baked Potato, Pumpkin Pie, and preferably a Honey Bottle!
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage1: Whether it's a kitchen or a farm, as long as it's a place full of rustic charm and everyday life, it will do perfectly.
No worries, if you're busy, take care of your own matters first. Just take a look for me whenever you have some free time.

I've wandered around the area for a few days, and I have a rough idea now. Next, I want to see how this place produces its ingredients. If it's convenient, could you take a photo of some farm animals? Chickens, pigs, cows, or sheep—any will do, as long as it captures that lively rustic charm!
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage2: Then I'll definitely be a regular here. You keep this lunch bag. Once I've completely perfected my new recipes, I'll be sure to treat you to a hot meal!
Even though you couldn't help much this time, I actually quite like it here and plan to stay a bit longer.
The heat is still a little off, but I'm already reluctant to leave this place. Take this lunch bag for now. Once I've thoroughly figured out the locals' tastes, I'll serve up my new signature dish.
Regardless, I've finally gotten some of my cooking touch back. While the inspiration is still hot, I need to carefully ponder over next season's new menu.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage3: Lately, I've been pondering how to perfectly blend local home-style flavors with the tastes of travelers from all over. When I finally make it, you have to come take the first bite!
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_visit_: I've developed quite a few new dishes while staying here. I must say, the patrons at this inn really know their food.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_gem_merchan: Many thanks. At least my life is spared, and I salvaged part of the cargo. Where there's a mountain, there's firewood to be found!
Very well. A true merchant doesn't rely solely on a fancy wagon to make a living. Even with just these remaining samples, it's enough for me to turn things around.

Those bandits on the road didn't take my life, but they smashed my wagon and sample chests to splinters! If you could spare eight Leather, twelve String, and six Iron Ingots, I might just be able to salvage the remaining goods.
Any decent-sized mine will do, as long as I can see the direction of the ore veins. I'm not picky.
No harm done. Caution is essential in business anyway. I'll just focus on sorting out the mess I have on hand first.

I've sorted through the presentable samples and old ledgers I have left, but it's not enough. I need to confirm if this place is worth long-term investment. If you ever go down a mine, snap a photo of an ore vein for me. I want to see the quality of the minerals here and if there's a big deal to be made.

Though you couldn't help much this time, we did cross paths. Have this Nether Star. A shrewd merchant doesn't close a deal every time, but I know who's worthy of my most prized treasures. I must hit the road again to find a more suitable place to settle.
The ledgers and sample chests have been recounted, and my remaining travel funds tallied. Now, I really need to carefully scheme how to turn this into a massive enterprise.
Fantastic! The cargo chests are fixed, and the ore quality far exceeds my expectations. Take this Nether Star—it's strictly not for sale, but consider it an extra reward for saving my life!

Still missing a little something. Though you helped me secure some of my capital, and this place has potential, it's not enough for me to wager everything. Take this Nether Star; I plan to scout for opportunities elsewhere.

Lately, I've been inventorying a batch of top-tier goods I rarely show to anyone. The patrons here have good taste; they don't just stare at the price tags when buying, which is incredibly rare these days.

I'm checking old ledgers today. Truthfully, the hardest part of business is having an eye for it—knowing exactly who and what places are worth your dedication. Compared to that, the valuable goods are secondary.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_minstrel_st: Wonderful! Inspiration is like the wind through the forest—if you don't jot it down quickly, it slips away the moment you turn your head.
That's alright, I can still hum a few melodies without paper. At worst, I'll just memorize them in my head and sing them a few times to make them stick.

I've gathered quite a few tunes on this journey, but my parchment is almost full and my ink is running dry. Could you lend me five pieces of Paper and an Ink Sac? Next time we meet, I'll sing you a brand-new song!
No need to go out of your way. As long as it's a place with a wide, sweeping view that lifts the spirit, it will be perfect.
No worries. Sometimes, melodies gain more charm when they settle in the heart for a while. Let's wait for another chance.

I've seen many beautiful sights on this journey, but the chorus still lacks a certain imagery. If you pass by a plains biome, could you bring back a photo with a wide, open view? It might be the perfect finale for this song.
It seems we lacked a bit of luck this time. No matter; people miss their moments, and songs have their unfinished verses. I must continue my journey. Until we meet again.
I owe so much to your help along the way. Whether it was the paper and ink you lent me, or the scenery of the plains you brought back, I've kept it all in my heart.

You're right. I've been wandering for so long that I almost forgot: a good song doesn't have to be finished on the road. Keep this music disc for now. Once I smooth out the rest of the melody, I'll come back and sing it to you.

The song is finished, but my journey is far from over. I'm giving you this music disc as a token of the unfinished stories I'm leaving here. After I travel to more places and fill in the rest of the tale, maybe one day I'll circle back to this inn.
I'm actually quite willing to slow my pace now. The lively chatter in the inn, the clinking of tankards, and the evening breeze are far more pleasant than rushing endlessly on the road.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_minstrel_vi: I'm trying to find the right melody for those lyrics I wrote a few days ago. The atmosphere here is truly wonderful, perfectly suited for slowing down and polishing my work.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_noble_stage: Finally, I no longer have to look as though I just crawled out of a mud pit. I, Ashford, shall remember this favor.
Very well. If an ancient name must rely solely on a few yards of fabric and gilding to keep up appearances, then there wasn't much glory left to it anyway.

Let me be clear, I am not begging for charity. I simply wish to make my attire presentable. If you could provide two Gold Ingots and sixteen White Wool, it would at least keep me from looking so destitute.
Even a photo of broken windows and ruined walls will do. I only wish to catch a glimpse of its former grandeur.
I suppose so. After all, not everyone has the leisure to go pay respects to a crumbling old mansion.

There are precious few proper estates left on this continent now. If you happen to pass by a Woodland Mansion, please take a picture for me. I want to see just how much of the old world's dignity remains.

Excellent. With this capital secured, I must admit that this inn is far more respectable than I initially presumed. Please accept this old pocket watch; it is the only decent token of gratitude I can currently offer.

Don't misunderstand, it's not that I'm reluctant to leave. I simply cannot be bothered to explain my lineage to yet another group of strangers. At least there's a place to rest here, and the food is somewhat palatable.

I thought this would be but a brief stay. Yet, once you grow accustomed to the comfort of lit lamps and opened doors again, returning to a life of exile is difficult. Having nothing else to repay you, please, you must take this old pocket watch.

I have thought a great deal these past few days. Regardless of how much past glory remains, I must find a place to re-establish myself. Could you lend me four Emeralds and one Diamond as starting capital? I shall keep this debt firmly in mind.
Lately I've been learning how to live like an ordinary guest, rather than sulking like a bitter soul waiting for the past to apologize to me. To be honest, this place has quite a charm to it.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_noble_visit: Having stayed here so long, I've gradually let go of much of my past. My mind is finally at peace.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_old_knight_: Phew, finally done. At least this old set of armor will sit securely on my shoulders once more.
So be it. A true veteran must learn to stand tall, even in broken armor.
My old shield can still take a beating, but the straps on my armor are falling apart. Could you lend me six Iron Ingots, four Leather, and eight Red Wool? I need to give this gear a proper repair.

Thank you for helping me get this old gear back in shape. I fixed what could be fixed, and I'll just have to make do with the rest. You know, once a man stops to catch his breath, he can't help but wonder where his path leads next.
Perhaps that is for the best. Take this old shield; it has warded off many disasters for me over the years.
It is not yet time to hang up my armor. No matter, an old soldier's fate is to keep marching forward. When I finally tire of the road, I'll come knocking on your inn's door again.

After resting here for a few days, these old bones finally ache a little less. When you get on in years, you no longer want to brave the wind and rain every day. Those heavy memories and past glories... it is time they found a place to rest.
Lately, I've been trying to get used to mornings without the sound of a charging horn. Truth be told, these leisurely days at the inn are far more comfortable than living on the edge of a blade.
Oho, I've brought quite a few rare goods from distant lands this time.
This price is for you alone. You won't find a deal like this anywhere else.
Take a look! My wares will surely open your eyes to the wonders of the world.
These are fresh novelties rarely seen on the market. Won't you take one with you?
Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
Rare goods from distant lands — see anything you like?
dialogue.otherworldinn.wandering_trader_: Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
Such freezing weather, yet your winter vigil here is burning with life! Care for some specialties from foreign lands?
Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
The harbor is full of grain ships, a true scene of bountiful harvest. Innkeeper, would you care to buy some rare goods?
Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
I've traveled far and wide, and night markets are everywhere, but your town's is the liveliest. Come pick out some wares—you won't find these anywhere else.
This time I've brought fresh novelties rarely seen on the market. What might you be looking for?
It's rare to catch the Spring Festival. I've docked my ship to rest for a couple of days, and your town is bustling! Want to see the exotic trinkets I brought from afar?

jei.otherworldinn.inn_key.info: Sneak + right-click a Create Desk Bell within the inn area to toggle the inn between open and closed.
jei.otherworldinn.inn_upgrade_voucher.in: When the upgrade conditions are met, right-click to raise the inn's star rating.
jei.otherworldinn.land_deed.info: Right-click a block to set the first corner, right-click again to set the opposite corner, and a third time to confirm and pay. It costs 2 coins per block, and areas already inside the inn are not charged again. The expandable area is limited by the inn rating; a higher rating allows a larger expansion. The selection is cancelled automatically if it goes beyond the allowed region.
jei.otherworldinn.messy_bed_sheet.info: Hold right-click while looking at water, a waterlogged block, or a cauldron to wash it clean. Washing in a cauldron has a 50% chance to not consume durability.
jei.otherworldinn.nether_space_sphere.in: This item has no use by itself; it is an intermediate material in a crafting chain.
jei.otherworldinn.npc_store.title: Store Products
jei.otherworldinn.organic_fertilizer.inf: Right-click to trigger one random tick on the target block, letting it fertilize crops that vanilla bone meal cannot, such as sugar cane and cactus, and also speed up grass spread.
jei.otherworldinn.picnic_box.info: Right-click to eat the first food stored inside the box. Only food eaten from the picnic box restores fatigue. Food can only be inserted in the Town or Magic Space dimensions; you cannot refill it while exploring. Each use has a 15-second cooldown. Sneak + left-click to empty the box and return the food to your inventory.
jei.otherworldinn.recall_scroll.info: You get one automatically when leaving the Town. Hold right-click for 3 seconds to teleport back to the Town inn. Cannot be used while inside the Town; works from any other dimension, such as the Nether or the End.
jei.otherworldinn.room_key.info: Right-click a block inside a room to bind the key to that room. Right-click a waiting guest to check them into the bound room, consuming one key. It fails if the room is full or the guest has already checked in or out. Left-click a block inside the room to unbind the key.
jei.otherworldinn.room_register.info: Hold it in the off-hand and right-click one corner of a room, then the opposite corner. When conditions are met (size within limits and at least one bed and one door), the room is created automatically. Right-click with the main hand to show the current room count and highlight the room outline.
jei.otherworldinn.space_sphere.info: Using it unlocks map-point teleportation for the whole team, letting you click map markers directly in the Town map view to teleport to the destination.

1→dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_midsumm: I built that grand wooden stage for the festival with my own two hands! It's solid as a rock, so dance your hearts out—it won't collapse!
2→dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_spring_: I've got plenty of timber, stone, and brick to spare. What kind of building materials catch your eye?
3→dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_spring_: Town repairs kick off right after the festival, so I'm resting my bones while I can. What's up? Looking to buy some building materials?
4→dialogue.otherworldinn.builder_spring_: Leave it to me. Browse through the blueprints first—which design catches your eye?
5→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.greetin: Hey there! Come take a look at this newly butchered batch. It doesn't get any fresher than this!
6→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.greetin: The cuts of steak are looking prime today. Care to take a couple home for a taste?
7→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.greetin: Watch your step! I just scrubbed the floors and they haven't quite dried yet.
8→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.greetin: Prime cuts of fresh meat right here!
9→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.greetin: Just tell me which cut you fancy and I'll slice it for you. Don't just stand there poking at them!
10→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.node.r: Fresh meat, freshly butchered! Which cut are you looking for?
11→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_deep_w: When the frost bites, you need hearty meat to keep the cold at bay! And what's a vigil feast without a steaming pot of meatball stew?
12→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_harves: Leave the grand festival roasts to me! Just look at the marbling on this pork belly—hogs raised in a harvest year are truly in a league of their own!
13→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_midsum: All the night barbecue stalls get their supply from me. Rest assured, there's plenty of fine meat to go around!
14→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_spring: Raw meat, leather, bones—I've got it all. Come see me anytime you're short on quality ingredients!
15→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_spring: Spring lamb is at its most tender! If you're planning a festival feast, I'll carve it up fresh—guaranteed to satisfy!
16→dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_spring: Beef and pork fly off the shelves the fastest, though it really depends on the season.
17→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.greetin: Perfect timing! Give me a hand hauling this sack of seeds over there.
18→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.greetin: The weather's been off this year. I'd better hurry back and check on the fields.
19→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.greetin: Care for a taste? Freshly picked and bursting with flavor.
20→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.greetin: Looks like rain again. The crops won't survive another endless downpour.
21→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.node.ro: Just hauled in a fine harvest from the fields. What can I get you?
22→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer.node.to: You actually managed to fix it? Thank you so much! This is going to make farming a whole lot easier!
23→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_deep_wi: The ground is frozen solid, so I can finally catch my breath. Don't worry, we've got plenty of hearty grain and cellar greens to go around!
24→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_harvest: It's a bumper harvest this year! Just look, the storehouse is bursting at the seams. Take your pick—it's all freshly threshed grain!
25→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_midsumm: The crops are growing like weeds lately, and the night breeze is nice and cool. It's the perfect time for a stroll along the field ridges.
26→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_spring_: Seeds, crops, and farming tools—I've got them all. Here, take a look.
27→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_spring_: Look how beautifully the fields are blooming! The Spring Festival is here—why not pick up some seeds and saplings to spruce up your own courtyard?
28→dialogue.otherworldinn.farmer_spring_: That greenhouse across the way has been abandoned for years... Back in its prime, the vegetables we grew there were absolutely luscious.
29→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.gree: The water's lively today. Did you manage to catch anything?
30→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.gree: If you're here to sell fish, just toss them in the crate nearby. I'll collect them in a bit.
31→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.gree: I've got some spare bait and tackle here. Need any?
32→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.gree: Been sitting here all morning. The fish in these waters sure are patient.
33→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.gree: Looking to buy some fresh fish?
34→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.node: Lady Luck is smiling today. Want a look at this fresh haul?
35→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_deep: Brrr, the sea breeze is biting cold; the harbor might just freeze over. If you're craving a hot bowl of fish soup to warm your bones, I've saved some fine catches for you.
36→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_harv: The fields aren't the only things yielding a harvest—the sea is too! The catches these past few days have been incredibly bountiful!
37→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_mids: Nights like this are perfect for catching nocturnal fish. With the festival lanterns reflecting on the water, even the fish have grown bold.
38→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_spri: Fresh fish, seafood, and all sorts of oddities dredged up from the depths.
39→dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_spri: Just keep steady and have patience. Fish bite more often in the rain, though it naturally depends on the season and the hour.
40→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.greetin: Welcome! Fresh stock just arrived, still warm from the journey!
41→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.greetin: The prices are set, so just pick out whatever you need.
42→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.greetin: I can't go any lower! I'm already giving you the regulars' discount.
43→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.greetin: What can I get for you today?
44→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_deep_wi: Fresh festival goods and fireworks have just arrived! The vigil ought to be loud and lively. Come on in and pick out some fine wares!
45→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_harvest: My word, the shelves are practically bursting this year! Pumpkin pies, grand cakes, and all sorts of festive ingredients—we've got more than enough!
46→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_midsumm: I've got all the records and snacks stocked up for the festival night. Once the out-of-towners arrive, they'll be gone in a flash!
47→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_spring_: Just a collection of peculiar little trinkets. Feel free to browse.
48→dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_spring_: The Spring Festival specials are fresh on the shelves! Saplings, fertilizer—we have it all. Don't miss out if you're looking to spruce up your home!
49→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: I need to set out before dawn tomorrow. Have the kitchen prep my rations early, if you would.
50→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: I've been hauling goods all day! Fetch me a bowl of piping hot stew, and make it quick!
51→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: The wheel hub on my wagon is coming loose. Is there a blacksmith anywhere near here?
52→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: This pack has worn my shoulders completely numb. I desperately need a good night's sleep.
53→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: I'll be passing through again on my return trip. Make sure to keep a prime room ready for me.
54→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: The mountain pass ahead is treacherous. I need to gather my strength before hitting the road again.
55→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: Hauling a caravan this size makes finding a safe haven a rare blessing indeed.
56→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: I'll leave these cargo crates here for now. Keep them out of the damp, whatever you do.
57→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pa: The skies look like they're brewing a storm. Thank the heavens I found a place to bed down.
58→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: My bones feel like they're falling apart. A hot bath right now is a blessing from the gods.
59→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: The bed looks soft enough. I just hope the quilts aren't too thin.
60→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: I've got to hit the road first thing tomorrow, so I really need to rest my weary feet tonight.
61→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: The hearth is roaring away nicely. Sitting here with a good book would be quite pleasant.
62→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: I've heard the signature dishes here are second to none. I must give them a try tonight.
63→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: Ah, this place is so nostalgic. It's exactly like the old tavern I stayed at when I was a child.
64→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: The morning breeze is incredibly refreshing. It's the perfect time for a stroll outside.
65→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: On dreary, rainy days like this, there's nothing cozier than curling up in the inn.
66→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: A friend highly recommended I lodge here, and it certainly lives up to its reputation.
67→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: The next time I pass through these parts, I'll definitely be staying here again.
68→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: The wind is howling wickedly out there. Thank goodness it's warm and peaceful inside the inn.
69→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary: Phew... It's even warmer here than I imagined. Looks like I'll finally get a peaceful night's sleep.
70→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_bus: This place is quiet enough. It's quite suitable for discussing serious business.
71→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_lin: The sheets feel agreeable enough. Are they pure cotton?
72→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_qui: I paid a hefty sum of gold specifically for peace and quiet. See to it that I'm not disappointed.
73→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_ref: Not bad at all. I shall recommend this establishment to my more discerning acquaintances.
74→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_roo: The room's decor is rather elegant, though it lacks a proper place to hang my overcoat.
75→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_ser: As long as the service maintains this standard, I shall become a regular patron.
76→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_sta: For the price I paid, I'd say your service is well worth the coin.
77→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_tip: You've been most accommodating. I'll be sure to leave a generous tip upon my departure.
78→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_vie: The view from the window is quite charming, though it's a pity one cannot see the sea.
79→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_win: The meal is quite good, but a glass of fine wine to accompany dinner would make it truly exquisite.
80→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: Thank you for preserving the authentic spirit of this place. It's a rare treasure in these times.
81→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: There is a genuine warmth of home here, and everyone is so remarkably kind.
82→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: I eagerly anticipate what this inn will become. I will be watching its journey closely.
83→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: It warms my heart to see this inn gradually bustling with life once again.
84→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: Should you ever need advice on running the establishment, my door is always open.
85→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: The atmosphere here is absolutely divine! I must take a pictograph to commemorate my visit.
86→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: I must recommend this to my friends when I return. Such a wonderful sanctuary shouldn't be kept a secret.
87→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: Staying here is vastly more comfortable since the renovations. Your hard work has truly paid off.
88→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: Keep up this momentum, and you'll have my patronage for a long time to come!
89→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_: The charm of the old inn has been flawlessly preserved. Such heartfelt dedication is truly rare.
90→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: My itinerary is strictly confidential. Should a single whisper escape these walls, I will hold you personally responsible.
91→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: I am accustomed to traveling in grand style. I expect your service to rise to the occasion.
92→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: My luggage is worth a king's ransom. Your security detail had best not falter.
93→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: This little inn does show a glimmer of investment potential. I shall keep a watchful eye on it.
94→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: A classic inn truly stands apart. The furnishings, the heritage—you simply don't find this depth in newer establishments.
95→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: True elegance lies in the details. The loft of this pillow, for instance, must be absolutely perfect.
96→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: I detest being disturbed. See to it that your servants don't bother me unnecessarily.
97→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: Send your sharpest attendant to serve me. Do not insult me with some clumsy novice.
98→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: This suite is barely passable. I expect there to be absolutely no racket during the night.
99→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_ri: The ornaments on these walls show a modicum of taste. I do hope they aren't forgeries?
100→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_adv: Serve me well, and you'll find yourself richly rewarded with coin.
101→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_adv: My retinue will arrive shortly. Have their lodgings fully prepared beforehand.
102→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_fee: The service protocols here are remarkably rigorous. I shall record my findings truthfully.
103→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_ord: You've been most attentive hosts. I'll be sure to spread word of your good name.
104→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_ord: My itinerary is fully booked. Ensure you wake me precisely on time tomorrow morning.
105→dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_ord: If you could send a pot of freshly brewed hot tea to my chambers, that would be splendid.
106→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.gree: Oh, it's you. Give me a moment to finish processing this potion—
107→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.gree: Careful now! That shelf is full of highly unstable mixtures. Best not to touch anything.
108→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.gree: I foresaw your arrival. Are you seeking potions this time, or looking for an enchantment?
109→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.gree: Welcome. Are you ready to part with your coin, or just browsing my mystical wares?
110→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician.node: Who is the enchanting witch standing before you? That's right, it's me! ~ What magical little trinket do you desire?
111→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_deep: These long winter nights are perfect for quiet reading and experiments, and the constellations are so clear... Just tell me what potion you require.
112→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_harv: Even the air carries the sweet scent of harvest—truly a generous season. Care to peruse my latest arcane stock?
113→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_mids: The night's glow is utterly captivating... I'm currently attempting to brew a luminescent floral nectar. Were you looking to buy something?
114→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_spri: The alchemical materials and magical scrolls are all here. Take your pick of whatever catches your eye.
115→dialogue.otherworldinn.magician_spri: The breath of reviving life is absolutely perfect for fermenting potions... Oh? A customer? Feel free to browse if you're looking to buy.
119→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.ask_go: What do you have for sale?
1→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.small_ta: Care to lend a hand with the construction?
2→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.small_ta: Which cuts of meat are selling best lately?
3→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.small_ta: Care to share any of your fishing secrets?
4→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_al: Leave it to me. I'll get that picture for you.
5→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_al: Apologies, but I can't spare the time for this journey.
6→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_al: Apologies, but I don't have the materials you need on hand.
7→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_al: Very well, I shall await your good news.
8→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_al: I look forward to the results of your next experiment.
9→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_al: Take care of yourself, and don't push too hard.
10→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Then I'll wait for you to brew a more stable potion.
11→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Take it easy, and try not to blow yourself up.
12→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Be sure to show me your new potion once it's brewed.
13→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Then take your time brewing over that cauldron.
14→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Here, take these to tide you over.
15→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Perhaps... you should try brewing another batch?
16→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: I think both you and these potions should stay here for now.
17→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Regardless, at least you've regained your feel for heat control.
18→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Look on the bright side—at least you've managed to brew a finished product.
19→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Alright, I'll be sure to capture a few pictures for you when I get there.
20→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Apologies, but I might not come across ruins like that on this trip.
21→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: I'm truly sorry, but I'm lacking those tools myself.
22→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Understood, I know what to focus on in the pictures.
23→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Then I shall look forward to your next great discovery.
24→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Keep up the hard work, and may you soon uncover the truth.
25→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Then strike while the iron is hot, and unearth the secrets hidden behind this.
26→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Many thanks. I'll gladly accept this archaeology brush.
27→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: You'd best work hard, and don't forget to bring back the evidence.
28→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Be careful when you go down into the ruins, and don't push yourself too hard.
29→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: I look forward to your new discoveries.
30→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: I'll be waiting to read your newly compiled notes.
31→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: Take these tools to make do for now.
32→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: From what you're saying, you've waded quite deep into these mysteries.
33→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: I've brought back the ruin samples you requested.
34→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: In that case, you should continue digging around here.
35→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_a: I've brought back your samples. See if they're what you need.
36→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_c: Rest assured, I'll keep an eye on these waters when I set sail.
37→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_c: I'm truly sorry, but I don't think I'll be of much help on this voyage.
38→dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_c: I have no supplies to spare. You might have to find another way.
